_why: The handoff split: SKILL.md stays under budget, and each moved mode body keeps a stub that links it, says when to read it, and lists its subheadings.

mutations.name: read-stub-loses-its-trigger
mutations._mechanism: The READ stub no longer says it must be read in full on every entry point.
mutations.find: in full before Step 0a, on every READ

mutations.name: takeover-stub-drops-its-link
mutations._mechanism: The TAKEOVER stub stops linking its reference.

mutations.name: handover-stub-forgets-the-subroutine-entry
mutations._mechanism: HANDOVER is also entered from WRITE; the stub stops saying so.

mutations.name: a-moved-subheading-is-unlisted
mutations._mechanism: A SKILL.md §"…" cross-reference to a moved subheading can no longer be resolved.
